text.p: Lithuanian newspapers carried the following reports in their Friday editions. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Industry and Trade Minister Kazimieras Klimasauskas expects deflation in Lithuania next summer.
- Lithuanian parliament adopted law creating Free Economic Zone in the port city of Klaipeda.
- Energy Minister Saulius Kutas, 61, had a successful heart operation on Tuesday.
- Finance Minister Algimantas Krizanauskas said the country's 700 million litas budget deficit will be fully covered by government T-bills.

- German consultants warned Lithuanian Dairy Association that the EU might ban import of dairy products from Lithuania as local companies continue to export poor quality products from Ukraine and Byelorussia.

- Deputy President of Nordic Investment Bank Erkki Karmila and Lithuanian Finance Minister Algimantas Krizinauskas signed $6.7 million loan agreement to finance construction of the ViaBaltica highway. Construction should start in Spring 1997 and end before 2000.
- Lithuanian President Algirdas Brazauskas has submitted to parliament draft amendment to penal code, calling for stricter measures against tax evaders including prison terms of up to four years.
